ambient_events: Cloud shadow slides across the floor in a slow, silent tide.
The city glitters on far below, a machine you are, for now, above.
description: The whole forty-fourth floor, inside the glass bowl at the top of the tower. One long room of glass and pale stone under a five-metre ceiling, the bay along the whole of one side and the mountains at the end, and none of it able to look back in. An emperor bed on a raised platform at the glass end, a sunken lounge in the middle, a private bar, and a fireplace of honed basalt in the one stone wall. Nothing up here is loud, because nothing up here has to be. Step south to the landing.

window.description: Floor-to-ceiling glass runs the whole west wall, black-framed and seamless, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the west window

name: The Solenne Penthouse
